description: This file defines a React component and corresponding Lexical editor node for embedding Twitter tweets within a web-based rich text editor. It includes component logic for loading Twitter's widget script, rendering embedded tweets, and serializing/deserializing tweet nodes.

classes.name: TweetNode
classes.description: A Lexical decorator node representing a Tweet, capable of serializing/deserializing and rendering an embedded tweet component within the editor.

methods.name: $createTweetNode
methods.description: Factory function to create a new TweetNode with a specified tweet ID.

methods.name: $isTweetNode
methods.description: Type guard to check if a node is an instance of TweetNode.
